Claim count is not event count or session revision. release persists testimony before resolving speaker/fragments/event insertion, so all later fallible operations require outer rollback/catch semantics. groups.id: Pre-issued objective binding and consumed custody transition
groups.trace: Generated manifests require exact provenance, regenerated authority and serialized objectives agreement. Evidence admission distinguishes physical exact custody from informational observer knowledge. Issuance gathers all matching objectives and requires exactly one per action before pending insertion; it never blindly takes an ambiguous objective. Each existing binding compared against party/recipient/case/objective/custodyversion and must remain unconsumed. Later pending-item conflicts can follow prior insertion, so local pending preflight alone does not prove atomic DB publication. Application rechecks living leader, exact revision/source/action/recipient, open case, objective and generated recipient, and current expected custody before mutation. Return/release/exchange pass current.version.saturating_add1 to already read canonical custody transition, then consumed_by only after success. Thus MAX version weakness is the same canonical custody exhaustion qualification recorded203, not separate unique errors for each caller. Other actions ingest a typed fact then consume binding.
groups.disposition: No unchecked local array/index defect. Preserve exact pre-issued binding and canonical custody successor with native transaction semantics.

groups.acceptance: Every accepted action consumes one exact authorized objective/custody version and publishes its fact coherently. Exhausted custody version cannot masquerade as a fresh version. Failed issuance/action must not leave a usable partial binding or mismatched fact.
